independent_source_review.decision: APPROVED FOR GREEN QUALIFICATION; no blocking source or test finding
conclusions: The only runtime delta is getBlockRange: seven additions and five deletions. Other production functions are unchanged.

Existing requested-range input bounds remain: nonnegative from, to >= from, and to no greater than Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Every raw block still passes strict parseBlock before existing out-of-range filtering.

For the nonempty inclusive range, block count must equal to - from + 1, and each retained height must equal from + index. Together these require the exact complete ordered range, rejecting missing endpoints/interior heights, duplicates and reordered answers.
Omitted block and an empty block array now correctly reject as INVALID_RESPONSE for a requested nonempty range; null/non-array responses remain rejected.

scanTron awaits the whole page before iterating and yielding. The web scan performs address balance and transaction memo lookups only after those yields, so the rejected page cannot produce new observations or address lookups.

The web mock now emits empty blocks for every requested height up to its fixed tip and retains the single funded block and special genesis response. Positive scan, deduction, sweep and network tests still exercise their original product semantics.

The three web omission cases remove the first, interior and last block of the initial page and require typed refusal, no discoveries, no account or memo calls and no broadcasts. Existing duplicate and positive cases remain.

The package adds an interior-gap regression and replaces the previous empty-answer success expectation with the required refusal. The omitted-genesis assertion changes to the earlier typed parser error, without removing refusal.
All four selected source/test/fixture blobs exactly match PR271 head429a4de8. PR321 cancellation runtime and its separate regression file are byte-identical to the base.

No dependency, transport policy, contract, release or workflow change is introduced by the selected code delta. Ownership/census documentation is separate; this review does not independently certify every census entry.
